title: Unsorted HashMap Serialization
pattern: Serializing unordered hash-based containers (`HashMap`, `HashSet`) directly to flat strings or byte payloads for network or storage propagation.
why_bad: Hash map iteration order is non-deterministic and randomized in modern runtimes to prevent hash-DoS attacks. Downstream clients or verifiers might implicitly depend on field order, causing signature mismatch bugs, or cache invalidation.
detection: Serializing a standard `HashMap` or `HashSet` to an external text or binary format.
counterexample:
Encoding to self-sorting schemas or utilizing the map solely for internal computation:
```rust
let key = map.get("id");
```
source: *Software Engineering at Google* by Titus Winters et al. (Chapter 8, p. 305).
